title: Database Configuration
description: The site's database connections — the single source of truth, read by Bootstrap::initDatabaseConnections() from data/databases.json.

databases.description: One entry per connection. Name them data, rep and users: those are the logical names the runtime resolves.

description.description: Free-text note about what this connection is for

connectionString.description: A PDO DSN (odbc:/sqlite:/mysql:/sqlsrv:/pgsql:) or an Access OLEDB string, which is converted to ODBC. Supports [relative/path] for a path under the site root and [env:NAME] to keep a secret in .env. Empty means the connection is not configured.

path.description: Optional explicit path to the database file, relative to the site root or absolute. The backup tool prefers this over parsing the connectionString.

type.description: Database kind. Advisory metadata: the actual driver comes from the connectionString. Only 'sqlite' changes behaviour — it gates the SQLite repair tool into the tools menu.

default.description: Preselect this database in the CMA database selectors. At most one entry may set it.

deprecated.description: Keep the entry for reference but treat it as retired: excluded from the portability check and from the SQLite gate.
